# The standard's rules

What holds each point of docs/STANDARD.md. `python3 scripts/lint.py --point N` lists the same.

## Works

### 1. Demo and tests

A module is held to it before it is marked ready.

A person looks: the demo company uses every part of it and nothing in the demo makes it look wrong.

- `features-checked`: a whitelisted method or OneAI tool no demo check reaches, past the count still left in a module (`tests/guards/test_coverage.py::test_no_module_has_more_left_to_cover_than_it_had`, caught in `test_the_scan_finds_a_call`)
- `coverage-ratchet`: a count still left that a new check lowered and nobody wrote down (`tests/guards/test_coverage.py::test_the_counts_are_lowered_as_checks_are_written`, caught in `test_the_ratchet_catches_a_count_left_high`)
- `screens-opened`: a desk page of ours no browser check opens on the demo (`tests/guards/test_browser.py::test_every_page_of_ours_is_opened_in_the_browser`, caught in `test_the_browser_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `atlas-demo`: a record type a person reaches that the demo has none of, beyond each module's count (`tests/guards/test_atlas.py::test_the_demo_has_one_of_everything_reached`, caught in `test_the_points_are_read`)
- `install-hidden-mandatory`: a shipped customization hiding a mandatory field, which stops a new site installing (`tests/guards/test_install.py::test_no_shipped_customization_hides_a_mandatory_field`, caught in `test_the_install_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `install-after-sync`: setup run in after_install, before the app's custom fields exist (`tests/guards/test_install.py::test_install_hooks_run_after_the_custom_fields_exist`, caught in `test_the_install_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `install-settled`: something after_migrate sets up that a new site never gets (`tests/guards/test_install.py::test_a_new_site_is_settled_as_a_migrated_one_is`, caught in `test_the_install_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `install-after-wizard`: a new workspace not settled once the setup wizard has made its company (`tests/guards/test_install.py::test_a_new_workspace_is_settled_once_its_company_exists`, caught in `test_the_install_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `demo-steps`: a demo step not built, or not in the demo's README (`tests/guards/test_demo.py::test_every_step_is_built_and_written_down`, caught in `test_the_demo_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `demo-apps`: an app People gives that nobody in the demo company is given (`tests/guards/test_demo.py::test_every_app_people_gives_is_given_to_somebody_in_the_demo`, caught in `test_the_demo_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `demo-suite`: an integration suite that writes, or checks next to nothing (`tests/guards/test_demo.py::test_the_suite_checks_and_writes_nothing`, caught in `test_the_demo_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `checks-read-what-is-there`: a demo check reading a name its module no longer has, which only a run on a demo site would find (`tests/guards/test_reaches.py::test_a_check_reads_only_names_that_are_there`, caught in `test_the_check_names_rule_catches_its_example`)
- `screens-opened-as-people`: a screen no browser check opens as a person of the demo company (`tests/guards/test_browser.py::test_every_screen_is_opened_as_a_demo_person`, caught in `test_the_browser_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `makes-not-stale`: a kind of record declared made that nothing makes any more (`tests/guards/test_makes_records.py::test_nothing_declared_is_stale`, caught in `test_the_making_rules_catch_their_examples`)

### 2. Rules on the server

- `empty-dates`: a < or <= on a date that may be empty, which frappe reads as the earliest day and so finds every record without one (`tests/guards/test_empty_dates.py::test_every_date_before_something_says_it_is_set`, caught in `test_the_guard_catches_a_snooze_with_no_is_set`)
- `rules-hooked`: a rule of One's not on its record's hooks (`tests/guards/test_rules.py::test_every_rule_is_on_its_records_hooks`, caught in `test_the_rules_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `rules-every-way`: a rule with no demo check that changes it by bulk edit, report view and import (`tests/guards/test_rules.py::test_every_rule_is_changed_every_way_on_the_demo`, caught in `test_the_rules_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `rules-no-way-round`: an endpoint writing a field a rule owns with frappe.db.set_value (`tests/guards/test_rules.py::test_no_endpoint_writes_round_a_rule`, caught in `test_the_rules_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `guard-sql-from-input`: a query whose text is built from a function's input or the request rather than passed as parameters (`tests/guards/test_oneguard.py::test_sql_takes_its_values_as_parameters`, caught in `test_the_sql_rule_catches_its_example`)
- `empty-dates-reviewed`: a date comparison added to the reviewed list, which only shrinks (`tests/guards/test_empty_dates.py::test_reviewed_only_shrinks`, caught in `test_the_shrinking_rule_catches_a_reason_left_behind`)

### 3. Hand-offs

- `handoffs-said`: a product README with no Connections section, or one naming no other product (`tests/guards/test_handoffs.py::test_every_product_says_its_connections`, caught in `test_the_hand_off_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `handoffs-run`: the demo suite not holding the hand-offs to the records they leave (`tests/guards/test_handoffs.py::test_the_suite_holds_every_hand_off`, caught in `test_the_hand_off_rules_catch_their_examples`)

### 4. What ERPNext already does

- `charts-format-through-frappe`: a frappe-ui chart or number card left to print its numbers the browser's way (`tests/guards/test_formats.py::test_every_chart_prints_through_frappe`, caught in `test_the_format_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `screen-company`: a screen of ours listing a company's records without the reader's company, beyond its count (`tests/guards/test_atlas.py::test_a_screen_lists_the_readers_company`, caught in `test_the_counts_catch_their_examples`)
- `no-country-in-generic`: code meant for every workspace that names one country (`tests/guards/test_any_country.py::test_nothing_generic_names_one_country`, caught in `test_the_country_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `regional-still-needed`: a regional file that no longer needs to be regional (`tests/guards/test_any_country.py::test_every_regional_file_still_needs_it`, caught in `test_the_country_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `money-says-currency`: a money figure without its currency, left to a heading to say (`tests/guards/test_any_country.py::test_a_money_figure_carries_its_currency`, caught in `test_the_country_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `tax-other-side`: a taxed figure that does not say the other side of tax on hover (`tests/guards/test_any_country.py::test_a_taxed_figure_says_the_other_side_on_hover`, caught in `test_the_country_rules_catch_their_examples`)

### 5. Settings and setup

A module is held to it before it is marked ready.

- `module-foot`: a module that draws its own settings dialog or foot, or a foot without its version (`tests/guards/test_ready.py::test_a_module_has_one_settings_dialog_and_one_foot`, caught in `test_the_declaration_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `setup-declared`: a module that does not say what setting it up takes, or a step nothing saves (`tests/guards/test_ready.py::test_a_module_says_what_setting_it_up_takes`, caught in `test_the_setup_tour_and_oneai_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `centres-open`: a centre that does not open from One's rail and from each module's Settings (`tests/guards/test_ready.py::test_every_centre_opens_from_ones_rail_and_from_each_modules_settings`, caught in `test_the_declaration_rules_catch_their_examples`)

## Stays desk

### 6. Tier declared

- `cards-shown`: a number card that names no record type, which frappe shows to nobody (`tests/guards/test_tiers.py::test_every_number_card_names_the_record_type_it_counts`, caught in `test_the_tier_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `islands-declared`: an island not declared, built and mounted (`tests/guards/test_islands.py::test_every_island_is_declared_built_and_mounted`, caught in `test_the_island_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `pages-on-shell`: a desk page that is neither an island nor one still leaving the shell (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_every_page_is_an_island_or_still_on_the_shell`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `shell-only-shrinks`: a page put on the shell, or a new user of it, after the screen contract (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_who_still_uses_the_shell_is_known_and_only_shrinks`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `heads-declared`: a Record Head not declared in the tier registry (`tests/guards/test_tiers.py::test_every_record_head_is_declared`, caught in `test_the_tier_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `pages-declared`: a page of its own not declared, or declared without why (`tests/guards/test_tiers.py::test_every_page_of_its_own_is_declared`, caught in `test_the_tier_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `collections-declared`: a list, calendar or tree set up and not declared (`tests/guards/test_tiers.py::test_every_collection_set_up_is_declared`, caught in `test_the_tier_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `views-declared`: one of frappe's views changed for a doctype in the desk's code and not declared in one/tiers.py (`tests/guards/test_tiers.py::test_every_view_we_change_for_a_doctype_is_declared`, caught in `test_the_tier_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `views-kept`: a view frappe offers taken away (`tests/guards/test_tiers.py::test_no_view_frappe_offers_is_taken_away`, caught in `test_the_tier_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `screens-declared`: a desk page of ours not declared with what it is (`tests/guards/test_tiers.py::test_every_desk_page_of_ours_is_declared`, caught in `test_the_tier_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `record-tabs-declared`: a record tab drawn outside the one place that draws them (`tests/guards/test_tiers.py::test_a_record_tab_is_declared_by_its_module_and_drawn_in_one_place`, caught in `test_the_tier_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `page-opens-view`: a page that opens a frappe view and draws anything of its own (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_a_page_that_opens_a_view_only_opens_it`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `shell-loses-pages`: a page put on the shell (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_the_shell_only_loses_pages`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `islands-built`: bench build not building the islands (`tests/guards/test_islands.py::test_bench_build_builds_the_islands`, caught in `test_the_island_rules_catch_their_examples`)

### 7. Our look

A module is held to it before it is marked ready.

A person looks: each screen, as each role, on a desktop and a phone: tokens only, frappe's controls, live where data changes, and the reader's formats.

- `shell-styles-shell`: anything but the shell styling the shell (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_only_the_shell_styles_the_shell`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `page-draws-no-shell`: a page drawing a part the shell draws (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_a_page_on_the_shell_draws_none_of_its_parts`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `centre-frame`: a centre drawing its own dialog, or a section its own body without saying why (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_every_centre_opens_in_the_frame`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `centre-tables-fit`: a table in a centre wider than its frame, cut or scrolling sideways (D16) (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_every_table_in_a_centre_fits_it`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `portal-look`: a page outside the desk without the portal (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_every_page_outside_the_desk_wears_the_portal`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `tabs-across`: a record's views run down the side of the page (`tests/guards/test_record_page.py::test_no_tabs_run_down_the_side`, caught in `test_the_record_page_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `tabs-scroll`: a row of tabs that sticks to the top of the page (`tests/guards/test_record_page.py::test_no_tab_row_sticks_to_the_top`, caught in `test_the_record_page_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `screen-modelled-on`: a screen of our own that does not name the app it is drawn after (`tests/guards/test_islands.py::test_a_screen_names_the_app_it_follows`, caught in `test_the_island_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `tabs-one-row`: a record's views drawn as tabs of their own, or a row that does not scroll when they do not fit (`tests/guards/test_record_page.py::test_a_records_views_are_the_one_tab_row`, caught in `test_the_record_page_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frappe-sidebar`: a page drawing its own record sidebar where frappe's form sidebar belongs (`tests/guards/test_record_page.py::test_no_page_draws_its_own_record_sidebar`, caught in `test_the_record_page_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `crumb-switch`: a module putting places of its own in the page head, or a crumb that is a menu of its own instead of the searchable switcher (`tests/guards/test_record_page.py::test_every_crumb_is_a_searchable_switcher`, caught in `test_the_record_page_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `phone-head`: a phone head that crams the breadcrumb and the page's buttons into one row (`tests/guards/test_record_page.py::test_a_phone_head_is_two_rows`, caught in `test_the_record_page_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `atlas-list`: a list that says nothing but a number, beyond each module's count (`tests/guards/test_atlas.py::test_a_list_says_more_than_a_number`, caught in `test_the_counts_catch_their_examples`)
- `alerts-one-alert`: an island drawing an alert of its own rather than the kit's OneAlert (`tests/guards/test_alerts.py::test_islands_draw_alerts_with_one_alert`, caught in `test_the_scans_would_catch_one`)
- `alerts-no-tint`: a note of ours tinted amber, red or another colour, rather than the form's grey card (`tests/guards/test_alerts.py::test_no_tinted_note_of_our_own`, caught in `test_the_scans_would_catch_one`)
- `alerts-no-icon`: an icon dropped into a note by hand, rather than onedesk.alert's round one (`tests/guards/test_alerts.py::test_no_icon_dropped_into_a_note`, caught in `test_the_scans_would_catch_one`)
- `icon-margin-sides`: an icon's top or bottom margin set and its sides left on frappe's auto, which floats it off its words (`tests/guards/test_alerts.py::test_an_icon_margin_sets_its_sides`, caught in `test_the_margin_scan_would_catch_one`)
- `figures-stat-card`: a record's head drawing figures other than as frappe's stat card (`tests/guards/test_figures.py::test_a_record_head_draws_frappes_stat_card`, caught in `test_the_figure_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `figures-one-card`: the desk's figure card not reading as frappe-ui's NumberCard (`tests/guards/test_figures.py::test_the_desk_card_reads_as_the_island_card`, caught in `test_the_figure_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `figures-through-kit`: an island drawing figures other than through the kit's Figures (`tests/guards/test_figures.py::test_an_island_draws_figures_through_the_kit`, caught in `test_the_figure_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `shell-makes-its-pages`: a page on the shell that makes its own page (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_a_page_on_the_shell_is_made_by_it`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `shell-whole`: the shell missing a part its pages call, or not loaded on every desk page (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_the_shell_has_its_parts_and_is_loaded_everywhere`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `shell-old-names`: one of Settings' old part names (os-row, os-card) back in the code (`tests/guards/test_frame.py::test_the_old_names_are_gone`, caught in `test_the_frame_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `icons-current`: fixtures/custom_icon.json not what brand/ makes (`tests/guards/test_generated.py::test_the_icon_fixtures_are_current`, caught in `test_the_reference_and_icon_checks_catch_a_stale_file`)
- `interface-icons`: a declared tab, field or link with an icon frappe does not draw (`tests/guards/test_interface.py::test_every_icon_is_one_frappe_draws`, caught in `test_the_interface_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `interface-fields-real`: a declared tab or field its record type does not have (`tests/guards/test_interface.py::test_every_tab_and_field_is_its_record_types_own`, caught in `test_the_interface_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `interface-cards-declared`: a head card or track no head row or chart of its module gives (`tests/guards/test_interface.py::test_every_card_and_track_is_a_row_its_module_declares`, caught in `test_the_interface_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `interface-four-cards`: a record's head with more than four cards (`tests/guards/test_interface.py::test_a_head_has_at_most_four_cards`, caught in `test_the_interface_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `interface-strip-real`: a strip counting a field its record type lacks, or naming values it does not have (`tests/guards/test_interface.py::test_a_strip_counts_a_field_its_record_type_has_and_names_only_its_values`, caught in `test_the_interface_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `interface-links-real`: a declared link to a record type that does not exist, or with fields it lacks (`tests/guards/test_interface.py::test_a_link_opens_a_record_type_that_exists_and_carries_real_fields`, caught in `test_the_interface_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `interface-shared-icons`: a shared field or type icon frappe does not draw (`tests/guards/test_interface.py::test_every_shared_icon_is_one_frappe_draws`, caught in `test_a_label_goes_by_its_most_specific_phrase`)
- `window-one-folder`: the window's files outside js/one_interface and css/one_interface, or not all loaded, after the shell (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_interface_is_one_folder_loaded_after_the_shell`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-places-views`: an adapter placing a view's parts itself rather than handing them to frame.js's view() (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_view_says_what_it_has_and_the_frame_places_it`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-keeps-head`: the window moving a part of frappe's page head rather than adding beside it (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_window_adds_to_frappes_head_and_moves_none_of_it`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-styles-window`: anything but the window's stylesheet styling the window (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_only_the_window_styles_the_window`, caught in `test_the_window_scans_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-nav-pane`: the nav pane drawn other than as frappe's sidebar sized by its own variable (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_nav_pane_is_frappes_sidebar_resized_by_its_own_variable`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-back-forward`: Back and Forward that are not the browser's (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_back_and_forward_are_the_browsers`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-onecloud`: OneCloud on its page drawing a bar, address or status the window has (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_onecloud_on_its_page_draws_none_of_the_windows_parts`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-for-everybody`: a kind of view left off the window, or behind a preview switch (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_every_view_is_on_the_window_for_everybody`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-address-box`: an address box that is not the breadcrumbs at rest and frappe's search bar when typed in (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_address_box_is_frappes_search_bar`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-one-reload`: a second reload button beside frappe's (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_frappes_reload_is_the_one_in_the_address_row`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-wrapped-marks`: a wrapped view class whose mark it inherits, so its wrappers are skipped (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_each_wrapped_class_has_its_own_mark`, caught in `test_the_window_scans_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-new-first`: a list's New not leading the command row (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_lists_new_leads_the_command_row`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-filter-sort`: a list's Filter and Sort outside the commands, or its column heads not flat (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_filter_and_sort_are_commands_and_the_heads_are_flat`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-one-gutter`: a row of the window off the command row's gutter (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_every_row_sits_on_one_gutter`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-late-views`: an adapter for a view frappe loads late that does not wait for its class (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_view_frappe_loads_late_is_waited_for`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-count-paging`: a count and paging on a board, a calendar or a dashboard (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_only_views_of_pages_show_a_count_and_paging`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `window-tree-as-list`: a tree's commands and filters laid out other than as a list's (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_tree_is_laid_out_as_a_list`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-bars`: a frame with bars other than one across the top, one across the bottom and the rail (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_frame_is_a_top_bar_a_bottom_bar_and_the_rail`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-colour`: a frame not in the workspace's Frame Colour, with the ink that reads on it (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_frame_wears_the_workspaces_colour`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-taskbar`: a bottom bar not laid out as a taskbar: status first, the clock last (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_bottom_bar_is_a_taskbar`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-rail-edge`: the app you are in not marked on the rail's edge (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_app_you_are_in_is_marked_on_the_rails_edge`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-flat-marks`: an app's full-colour mark on a workspace colour, where its flat twin belongs (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_rails_marks_go_flat_on_a_workspace_colour`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-main-action`: a command row whose solid main action is not first on the left (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_main_action_is_always_first_on_the_left`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-details-pane`: a form's sidebar that is not the window's details pane holding the record panel (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_forms_sidebar_is_the_details_pane_and_holds_the_record_panel`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-names-no-doctype`: the window or the record panel naming a doctype, field or module (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_engine_names_no_doctype`, caught in `test_the_window_scans_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-one-tree`: a screen drawing a tree of its own rather than handing its rows to the window's (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_screen_with_a_tree_hands_its_rows_to_the_windows`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `frame-one-name`: the window called anything but OneInterface in its module, folders, classes or namespace (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_the_interface_has_one_name`, caught in `test_the_window_scans_catch_their_examples`)
- `phone-reaches-all`: an app or a bar tool a phone cannot reach (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_phone_reaches_every_app_and_every_bar_tool`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `phone-address-bar`: a phone's address bar not opening the address box as a desk's does (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_phones_address_bar_is_typed_into_as_a_desks_is`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `phone-sheet-pull`: a sheet that cannot be pulled down from its content at the top (`tests/guards/test_interface_frame.py::test_a_sheet_closes_from_anywhere_at_its_top`, caught in `test_the_window_rules_catch_their_examples`)

## Speaks

### 11. Notifications

A module is held to it before it is marked ready.

A person looks: it tells people what they need, on the channels that make sense, only to the roles that should hear it.

- `one-sender`: a mail or notification sent around the hub (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_nothing_else_sends`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `types-declared`: a notification sent that is not declared (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_every_type_sent_is_declared`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `types-say-needs`: a notification that does not say what it needs (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_every_type_says_what_it_needs`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `one-folder`: a notification declared anywhere but its own file in onedesk/notifications/ (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_nothing_declares_a_notification_anywhere_else`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `one-layout`: a notification file not named for its type or not in the one layout (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_every_notification_is_one_file_in_one_layout`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `types-say-channels`: a notification type that does not say its channels and its sender (`tests/guards/test_ready.py::test_a_module_says_how_and_from_whom_it_tells_people`, caught in `test_the_declaration_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `notify-when-whom`: a notification type not saying when and to whom in the one way (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_every_type_says_when_and_to_whom_the_same_way`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `notify-twin`: a twin notification type following a kind of another app (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_a_twin_follows_a_kind_of_its_own_app`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `notify-outside-mailed`: a type for people outside not mailed, or one for people inside not notified (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_outside_types_are_mailed_and_the_rest_notified`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `notify-slots-named`: a default text with a numbered slot rather than a named one (`tests/guards/test_notifications.py::test_slots_are_named`, caught in `test_the_notification_rules_catch_their_examples`)

### 18. Permissions and roles

A module is held to it before it is marked ready.

- `no-system-manager-code`: code that waits for System Manager (`tests/guards/test_roles.py::test_no_code_waits_for_system_manager`, caught in `test_the_role_rules_catch_their_examples`)

- `roles-shipped`: a module whose roles do not ship from its access.py (`tests/guards/test_ready.py::test_a_module_ships_its_roles`, caught in `test_the_declaration_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `grants-through-abilities`: a share written outside rights.grant (`tests/guards/test_ready.py::test_a_module_grants_through_abilities_alone`, caught in `test_the_declaration_rules_catch_their_examples`)

- `guard-unchecked`: a whitelisted function that reads or writes records past frappe's checks and checks nothing on the way (`tests/guards/test_oneguard.py::test_a_whitelisted_function_checks_permission`, caught in `test_the_unchecked_rule_catches_its_example`)

- `admin-granted`: what a workspace administers not granted to its administrator (`tests/guards/test_roles.py::test_what_a_workspace_administers_is_granted_to_its_administrator`, caught in `test_the_role_rules_catch_their_examples`)

### 19. Legal

A module is held to it before it is marked ready.

A person looks: what it does with data, read against what its clauses, subprocessors and optional services say.

- `legal-version`: a clause changed without a new revision or recorded hash (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_every_document_is_at_the_version_recorded`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `subprocessors`: a company One calls that is not a declared subprocessor (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_every_company_one_calls_is_a_declared_subprocessor`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `legal-assembled`: a module's legal file left out of the documents (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_every_modules_legal_file_is_assembled`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `nothing-promised`: an agreement promising what is not built (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_nobody_is_promised_what_is_not_built`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `legal-said`: a version that moves what a module agrees on without saying so (`tests/guards/test_ready.py::test_a_change_to_what_a_module_agrees_on_is_said`, caught in `test_the_folder_and_version_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `clauses-in-sections`: a clause in a section its document does not have (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_every_clause_is_in_a_section_its_document_has`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `terms-lifecycle`: terms describing a workspace's lifecycle the code does not run (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_the_lifecycle_the_terms_describe_is_the_one_the_code_runs`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `agreements-to-whom`: somebody agreeing to nothing, or anybody agreeing to a notice (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_everybody_agrees_to_something_and_the_notices_to_nothing`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `only-first-stops`: a later revision stopping somebody who agreed to an earlier one (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_only_a_first_agreement_stops_anybody`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `change-ahead`: a change to what a workspace agrees to taking effect before its notice period (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_a_change_is_published_ahead_of_the_day_it_takes_effect`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `model-runners-declared`: a company that runs a model OneAI uses and is not a declared subprocessor (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_every_company_that_runs_a_model_is_a_declared_subprocessor`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `services-call`: an optional service's host called other than through services.call (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_a_service_is_reached_only_through_services_call`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `duties-met`: a duty a law puts on us that no clause meets (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_every_duty_a_law_puts_on_us_is_met_by_a_clause`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `agreements-plain`: a clause in legalese, or of more than one point or 30 words a sentence (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_the_agreements_are_plain`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `core-change-waits`: a company One can't work without used before the day its notice said (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_a_core_change_waits_for_its_day`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
- `switchover-day`: a switchover running the new way before its published day (`tests/guards/test_legal.py::test_a_switchover_runs_the_old_way_until_its_day`, caught in `test_the_legal_rules_catch_their_examples`)
